reference.title: Cardio Product B: Contraindications and Precautions
reference.shortdesc: Information on safety, contraindications, and precautions for Cardio Product B.

section.title: Contraindications
section.p: Cardio Product B is contraindicated in patients with the following conditions:

ul.li: Known severe hypersensitivity to Cardio Product B or any of its excipients.
Severe cardiogenic shock or uncompensated heart failure requiring inotropic support.
Second-degree or third-degree atrioventricular (AV) block in the absence of a functioning pacemaker.

section.title: Precautions
section.p: Before administering Cardio Product B, consider the following safety precautions:

ul.li: Monitor blood pressure and continuous electrocardiogram (ECG) during administration.
Assess baseline renal function and serum potassium levels prior to initiating treatment.
Use with caution in patients receiving concurrent beta-blockers or calcium channel blockers due to the risk of additive bradycardia.
